learn.text:
What is a Material?

A material is any substance used to create an object. Common materials include paper, wood, cloth, glass, metal, plastic, clay, and so on.

Materials in Daily Life

Objects around us are made up of various materials such as paper, wood, cloth, glass, metal, plastic, clay, and others. For example, a notebook is made of paper, while a pen might contain metal or plastic.
